failures: Removing the curtain exposes the legacy134 dense bank-rock placements as a tall continuous trench, including a large near-camera rounded grey block. More vegetation should not be used to conceal this geometry problem.
New cast cut-end shoes show excessive nearly white highlights; finer timber still reads too heavy in the low view.
Roof/body/temple detail specificity and garden/canopy/light morphology remain substantially short of the reference.
